title: OCaml Temporal native client wait request
description: The absence of a follow_runs option is intentional: this operation waits for the named run (or, with an empty run_id, the run that is current when Temporal handles the poll) and never follows continued-as-new. Runtime validators also reject NUL-containing identifiers and enforce a 65,536-byte UTF-8 safety limit; maxLength is the corresponding character-count bound expressible in standard JSON Schema.

run_id.description: Exact run ID, or the empty string to select the workflow's current run, which Temporal resolves when it handles the request (#791).
